nativeSources.limitation: Archival government 5 m DTM; source building and terrain revisions differ. All fresh physical checks required.
nativeSources.provider: Lands Department / Hong Kong SAR Government

parentWaterMask.policy: Raw parent water/land classification preserved at every refinement node.

source.policy: Original native terrain facets in the core; 10m outer transition split on original parent triangle boundaries. Parent water mask retained. Source building geometry and elevations unchanged.

finalBoundarySnap.policy: All final native boundary vertices join the rendered root parent after clipping and hole filling.

numericalCoverageGap.qualification: Metadata declaration only: native float32 terrain geometry is unchanged. Existing full source contact, foundation and runtime/rendered sampler checks remain mandatory.

parentHoleFill.policy: Current parent terrain sampled only where recovered native TIN is absent and outside the protected source-model projection.

source.policy: Original source facets with bounded parent-edge transition; no AI geometry.

protectedParentProjection.policy: Exact original parent planes within the explicit mask; no invented heights. Entire source contact, foundation and all neighbour/runtime gates remain required.
